verdict.rationale: Ramp documents three official MCP servers: the account-scoped Ramp MCP at mcp.ramp.com/mcp with admin role controls and multi-business aliases, an unauthenticated Developer docs MCP, and a gated Ramp Data MCP, with setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients. Live probes confirm the production server is OAuth-gated per the MCP authorization spec with granular read/write scopes, and that the docs server answers an initialize call. Missing for 10: bill approvals are not yet available via MCP, and there is no hands-on tool-call or independent user corroboration beyond protocol-level probes.
